title: Credit Card APY Bonuses: Stacking Policy
summary: This document explains Rho-Bank’s Credit Card APY Bonus Stacking Policy: when a customer has multiple Rho-Bank credit cards with savings-account APY bonuses, the bonuses do not stack—only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied. It also states credit card APY bonuses can stack with other bonus types (e.g., checking APY boosts, relationship bonuses, account tier bonuses), and provides an example (EcoCard +0.6% only, not the sum of Gold +0.025%, Platinum +0.15%, and EcoCard +0.6%).
faqs: If I have multiple Rho-Bank credit cards, do their APY bonuses on my savings account stack?
How does the system choose which credit card APY bonus I receive?
What happens if my cards offer different APY bonus rates (e.g., +0.025%, +0.15%, +0.6%)?
Can credit card APY bonuses stack with other Rho-Bank bonuses like checking account APY boosts or relationship bonuses?
Do credit card APY bonuses stack with account tier bonuses?
Does the policy apply to savings-account APY bonuses tied to credit cards only?
